paite: Na ngaihnou koilam a pai ahia, Aw nang numeite lak a kilawm penpen? Amah na ngaihnou koilam a kiheita ahia, amah ka hon zonpih theihna ding un?
heading: Numeite

paite: Ka ngaihnou ahuan ah ahohsuk a, gimnamtui mun ah, huansung a vak in, lili pak lakhawm ding in.
heading: Numei

paite: Ka ngaihnou a ka hi a, ka ngaihnou kei a ahi; lili pak lak ah aganta aching hi.
Na kilawm hi, Aw ka it, Tirzah bang a kilawm, Jerusalem bang a deihhuai, na lauhuaina sepaih pawl puanlapte bang in ahi.
heading: La Ngana Pasal / Pasal

paite: Kei a kipan na mitte lakik in, amau lah ahon zouta ua. Na sam Gilead pang a kual kelhon bang ahi.
Na hate belamnuhon bang ahi ua, sil khit phet a hong paitoute; huai ah amaute chiat in phik anei ua, alak uah kuamah aching a-om kei uh.
Na mit laivomte theibuhfai them na maituamna liah a om bang ahi.
Kumpinu sawmguk a-om ua, mei sawmgiat, huan nungak siangthou sim seng louh.
Ka vahui, ka nin baang lou, khat kia ahi; anu lak a amah kia ahi; amah suang lak a ahoihpen ahi. Tanute'n amah amu ua, nuamsa achi uhi, ahi, kumpinute leh ameite'n amah aphat uhi.
Zingsang bang a dakkhia amah kua ahia? khapi bang a kilawm, ni bang a siang, sepaihhon puanlap bang a lauhuai?
Makhatang huan ah ka paisuak a, phaizang a sing suan hingte en ding in, grep apakmum hiam chih leh theibuhfai apakpalhta hiam chih en ding in.
Ahihkeileh ka theihkhiak ma in ka kha in ka lunglutna ka mipite kangtalai lak ah ahon koihta hi.
Hong kik in, hong kik in, aw Shulam mi; hong kik in, hong kik in, ka hon ettheihna ding un. Numei' Bangziak a Mahanaim mite lam en bang a Shulam mi en ding na hi ua?
